intro.heading: Clubs & Initiatives
intro.lead1: Our PTA is proud to support a range of enriching clubs and initiatives that help students explore their interests, build new skills, and grow in confidence beyond the classroom.
intro.lead2: These opportunities reflect our commitment to nurturing well-rounded learners and an inclusive, vibrant school community.
intro.contactNote: Want to get involved? Email us at jerseycityps5pta@gmail.com.
getInvolved.heading: Get Involved
getInvolved.body: Have ideas? We want to hear from you! Reach out at jerseycityps5pta@gmail.com.
getInvolved.item[0]: Join the PTA: Membership dues are $7 for individuals and $12 for families. Join online at https://ps5pta.givebacks.com/shop . (No time to volunteer? No problem! Your membership alone makes a difference.)
getInvolved.item[1]: Sign up for the weekly PTA newsletter at https://www.givebacks.com/communication/46ff2aab-3186-46fd-aa86-f32390abce61/status for information on upcoming events and summaries of school communications.
getInvolved.item[2]: Donate to the PTA! You can make tax-deductible contributions via Givebacks, or stay tuned for Colorfest, our big annual fundraiser. Visit https://ps5pta.org/donate to give.
getInvolved.item[3]: Bookmark https://www.amazon.com/shop/ps5pta and use it before you shop on Amazon; the PTA gets about 4% of items added to your cart through that link.
